clue.text: Egotistical in the extreme, if ideas not open to change?

definitions.meaning: someone utterly egotistical is wholly convinced of their own views and worth

definitions.text: if ideas not open to change?
definitions.meaning: a person whose ideas cannot be shifted is stubbornly sure of their own rightness

explanation.surface: A comment on someone so full of themselves that their mind is closed to any new thinking.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of IF IDEAS NOT OPEN come within one L of the answer, so an anagram tempts, but it falls short; read the clue as two descriptions of the same stubborn person.
explanation.definitionFit: Being conceited and unshakeably sure of your opinions is exactly what this hyphenated adjective describes.

clue.text: A new wine, for instance, put over fruit

indicators.note: in a down clue, put over means the pieces are turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: must is unfermented grape juice, new wine
as means for instance, like

explanation.surface: Instructions for serving fruit with a fresh glass of wine poured over it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put over' turns A + MUST + AS, giving SATSUMA.
explanation.definitionFit: A satsuma is a kind of small seedless mandarin orange, a citrus fruit.

clue.text: What's central to plot — to exploit despicable character

indicators.note: the central letters of plot are taken

parts.note: to use someone is to exploit them

explanation.surface: In a thriller, the core of the scheme is to take advantage of a villain.
explanation.definitionFit: Louse is a contemptuous word for a mean, despicable person.

clue.text: Bully removed from top press organisation

indicators.note: the first letter is taken off the word top

parts.note: taken as written
OR is taken as an abbreviation for organisation

explanation.surface: A tyrannical boss is ousted from a leading newspaper company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removed from' takes T away from TOP, leaving OP. OR for organisation is a loose abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: An oppressor is one who tyrannises others, as a bully does.

clue.text: Expression of surprise from Italian leader, for example

indicators.note: the leader of Italian is its first letter

parts.note: say means for example

explanation.surface: An Italian politician says something that shocks.
explanation.definitionFit: This exclamation is an old-fashioned British way to show astonishment.

clue.text: Popular girl turned up on an old vessel

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: a maid is a girl

explanation.surface: A well-liked young woman shows up aboard an antique ship.
explanation.definitionFit: An Indiaman was a large merchant sailing ship trading with India, an old vessel.

clue.text: Mexican food from tin served up, mostly spicy

indicators.note: in a down clue, served up means the word is read upwards

parts.note: a tin is a can

indicators.note: mostly means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: spicy means hot

explanation.surface: Tex-Mex snacks from a tin dished out, most of them hot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served up' turns CAN into NAC; 'mostly' trims HOT to HO.
explanation.definitionFit: A nacho is a tortilla chip, usually topped with cheese, a Mexican snack.

clue.text: Also including mother to cultivate fruit

indicators.note: the word for also includes, holds within it, the other letters

parts.note: too means also
ma is mother
to till is to cultivate land

explanation.surface: Advice that mum should grow fruit as well.
explanation.definitionFit: A tomatillo is a small green husk-covered fruit used in Mexican cooking.

clue.text: Girl and boy forming couple, as a rule

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, short for Diana
Archy is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A girl and a boy become a pair, as normally happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as a rule' looks like 'usually', but here means government: a couple ruling together.
explanation.definitionFit: A diarchy is government by two rulers jointly, a pair holding power.

clue.text: Decisive asset for club, perhaps, if the contract is right

definitions.meaning: a winning resource kept in reserve, as in the idiom about playing your strongest card

definitions.text: for club, perhaps, if the contract is right
definitions.meaning: in bridge or whist, a club card outranks other suits when clubs are the contracted suit

explanation.surface: A remark about a sports club's key player, valuable only if the deal signed is the right one.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiomatically, the card that beats all others stands for any resource that settles the matter.

clue.text: Butterfly repeatedly found in list

definitions.meaning: a European butterfly named for the white ...-shaped mark on its wing
a written list separates its items with this punctuation mark again and again

explanation.surface: A naturalist keeps spotting one butterfly species on the record of sightings.
explanation.definitionFit: The punctuation mark shares its name with a butterfly species bearing a white comma-shaped marking.

clue.text: Not balanced — isn't that odd?

definitions.meaning: a number that is not even is odd, read as the prefix un- on the word even

explanation.surface: Someone notices a lopsided arrangement and wonders aloud whether something is amiss.
explanation.definitionFit: Something irregular or lopsided lacks balance, and an odd number is also described this way.

clue.text: Choose alarm outside with all-round scanning

indicators.note: the word for alarm sits on the outside, wrapped around the word for choose

parts.note: alarm means panic
to choose is to opt

explanation.surface: Advice to pick a security alarm fitted outside that sweeps the whole area around it.
explanation.definitionFit: This adjective means seeing everything in one view, as with a panoramic all-round survey.

clue.text: Tune from America taking short time on a record-player

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the America-plus-time piece follows the disc jockey in the down-the-line order

parts.note: a DJ, disc jockey, is one who plays records
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A piece of music imported from the States being played briefly on a gramophone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tune' looks like a melody but is a verb, to set or regulate; 'record-player' is the person spinning discs, not the machine.
explanation.definitionFit: To tune an instrument or engine is to regulate it so it works correctly.

clue.text: Swedish heroine overturned arrangement that goes to bride's head

parts.note: Julie is the title heroine of Strindberg's play Miss Julie

indicators.note: in a down clue, overturned means read upwards

parts.note: a pact is an arrangement or agreement

explanation.surface: A Scandinavian heroine upsets a deal that was going to her head.
explanation.definitionFit: A Juliet cap is a small round mesh cap, often worn by a bride on her head.

clue.text: Work unit covering up a line in city out East

indicators.note: the work unit wraps around and conceals the other letters

parts.note: a man-day is a unit of work, one person's labour for a day

explanation.surface: A labour team hides a queue somewhere in an eastern city.
explanation.definitionFit: A major city in Myanmar, made famous in English by Kipling's poem about the road there.

clue.text: A rod can, in error, become excessively harsh as punishment

indicators.note: the letters are put into error, jumbled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Beating with a rod or cane, mistakenly applied, becomes a cruel penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after Draco, the Athenian lawgiver whose laws were famously severe.

clue.text: Easy to teach a learner

parts.note: to inform is to teach or tell
L is the learner sign on British cars

explanation.surface: A remark that instructing a novice is simple.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal means relaxed, casual, easy-going in manner.

clue.text: Check collective wisdom about burning gas

parts.note: CH is the chess abbreviation for check

indicators.note: the word for collective wisdom goes about, around, the word for burning

parts.note: lore is the traditional knowledge of a group
a fire that is still burning is said to be in

explanation.surface: An inspection of traditional knowledge concerning a fuel that burns.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a greenish-yellow chemical element that is a gas at room temperature.

clue.text: Definitive cold drink served in clubs repeatedly

indicators.note: the drink is served within the doubled card-suit letter
repeatedly means the letter for clubs is given twice over

parts.note: C is the card-game abbreviation for clubs
a lassi is a cold Indian yoghurt drink

explanation.surface: The ultimate chilled beverage is poured in nightclubs time and again.
explanation.definitionFit: A classic is the definitive, outstanding example of its kind.

clue.text: Hedge put down beside part of cricket field

parts.note: to lay something is to put it down
the off side is the half of a cricket field facing the batsman's bat

explanation.surface: A garden hedge is set down alongside a section of a cricket ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hedge' is not the garden shrub but a verb from betting: a bookmaker hedges by passing on part of a risky bet.
explanation.definitionFit: In betting, to lay off a wager is to pass part of the risk to another bookmaker, a way to hedge.

clue.text: Just seen with half a dozen Roman women?

parts.note: fair means just
sex is Latin for six

explanation.surface: Roman ladies seen keeping strictly to a group of six.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roman' points to Latin, not the numeral VI.
explanation.definitionFit: The fair sex is an old-fashioned collective term for women.

clue.text: States current acceptable high level of dislike

parts.note: avers means states or asserts
I is the physics symbol for electric current
on means acceptable, as in 'that's not on'

explanation.surface: A claim that the present amount of public hostility is tolerably high.
explanation.definitionFit: Aversion is a strong dislike or repugnance, a synonym of the definition phrase.

clue.text: Lacking a drink

definitions.meaning: a small measure of spirits, as opposed to a long drink

explanation.definitionFit: Short means deficient, and also a small strong drink of spirits.

clue.text: Tree from Orient, originally, restricted in basin artificially

indicators.note: the first letter is confined within the rearranged word
done artificially, the letters of basin are contrived into a new order
originally points to the first letter of Orient

explanation.surface: A tree brought from the East is grown in a pot, its growth artificially checked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'artificially' turns BASIN into BNSAI, and 'restricted in' puts O inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Bonsai is a tree kept miniature by pruning, an art that originated in China and Japan.

clue.text: Fixed tour of duty for flier

definitions.meaning: a set period of work or service
a small wading bird, a kind of sandpiper

explanation.surface: A pilot's assigned spell of service.
explanation.definitionFit: A stint is a set period of work, and also a small sandpiper.

clue.text: Ursa Minor, perhaps, seen when on a tropical island

parts.note: Ursa Minor means Little Bear, and a little bear is a cub

explanation.surface: An astronomer spots the Little Bear constellation while on a Caribbean holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: Not the constellation but the literal Latin, Little Bear: a young bear.
explanation.definitionFit: Cuba is the largest island in the Caribbean, lying in the tropics.

clue.text: Artistic technique that's succeeded — behold!

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded, as in genealogies
ecco is Italian for behold, here it is

explanation.surface: An exclamation of triumph when an art method works out.
explanation.definitionFit: Secco is a technique of wall painting on dry plaster, as opposed to fresco on wet.

clue.text: King in Hawaiian island returned case for another

indicators.note: the king's letter is put in the island's name

parts.note: Maui is one of the islands of Hawaii
R is short for rex, king

indicators.note: returned means the word for a case is read backwards

parts.note: a suit is a legal case

explanation.surface: A monarch on a Pacific island sends back a case to be swapped for a different one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' is the definition: another island, following on from Hawaiian island in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Mauritius is an island nation in the Indian Ocean, so another island after the Hawaiian one.

clue.text: Excellent poet's opposing a vote for levy on profit

parts.note: capital is an old-fashioned word for excellent
'gainst is the poetic shortening of against
X is the cross marked on a ballot paper

explanation.surface: A fine poet takes a stand against a ballot for a tax on gains.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the tax charged on the profit made when an asset is sold for more than it cost.
